atoms.b: Der Infinitiv des Passivs wird verwendet mit ((++Modalverben Hilfsverben Zeitformen)) und ihren Ersatzformen sowie mit Verben wie to ask, to expect, to hope oder to want. Bei Modalverben ((++ohne_to mit_to)) wird auch der Infinitiv des Passivs ohne to gebildet.

instruction.text: Welcher Satz enthält den Infinitiv des Passivs? Wähle ihn aus.

b: ++The rubbish should be thrown in the bin.
Throw the rubbish in the bin!
He threw the rubbish in the bin.
++Fish can be caught in the lake.
She can catch fish in the lake.
Catching fish in the lake is easy.
They will recycle their water bottles.
++Our friendship shouldn't be taken for granted.
I took our friendship for granted.
Don't take our friendship for granted.
++Her books might be stored in a better way.
She will store her books in a better way.
Her books have been stored in a better way.
